newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian pre-Easter wool prices seen steady.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian pre-Easter wool prices seen steady.

text.p: Australian wool prices are expected to remain steady at auctions in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle this week when about 101,675 bales will be offered, The Astralian Council of Wool Exporters said.
The positive note on which the market closed last week is expected to be continued this week, the council said in its weekly market preview.

Pastoral group Wesfarmers said this week's sales are the last before the two week Easter recess which is expected to force buyers to take stock to cover orders and provide the market with continued underlying support.

"However, significant upside is not expected due to a number of factors, particularly the large quantity of wool on offer as a result of growers stock attracted to auction by the firmer prices. Also, Chinese trading is relatively inactive in reaction to the firmer prices of recent weeks and the continued strength of the Australian dollar," Wesfarmers said.

Finally, there are large quantities of stock available from Wool International to fill the June quarter quota requirement. Upward movement is unlikely, therefore, and prices are expected to stabilise as we enter the break period, Wesfarmers said.
